summary: Full test of the new My Space module (backend API + UI) plus quick regression of existing modules. Created /app/backend/tests/test_myspace.py (29 tests, all passing) covering CRUD, pin, filters, search, visibility (private/team/company), owner-only edit/delete, cross-tenant isolation (Demo org -> 404), uploads (image upload/fetch, cross-user 403, >5MB rejected) and reminder->notification. UI tested end-to-end as staff (dhanusha.r) and admin (support@route39.in) on the preview URL: sidebar + mobile bottom nav entry, all 5 create types, rich-text bold, checklist progress, table add row/col + rename + numeric SIGMA total + sort, image upload with thumbnail, pin -> Pinned section, search, all filter tabs, delete with confirm, notification bell showing 'Reminder: TEST_Submit timesheet'. Found and fixed ONE critical crash in the attachment upload flow. All test data cleaned up.

minor.issue: MySpaceUpdate drops all None values, so a field can never be cleared (e.g. removing reminder_date or clearing content is impossible). Use exclude_unset instead of filtering None.
No validation of `type` or `visibility` enums — arbitrary strings are accepted and stored (e.g. type='foo' creates an item the UI renders with a fallback icon). Use Literal/enum in Pydantic.
Search regex is not escaped, so special chars (e.g. '(' or '[') would be interpreted as regex; consider re.escape.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: uploading a file/image crashed the app with 'TypeError: items.map is not a function' + red runtime overlay (whole page unusable). Root cause: Attachments.upload called onChange((prev)=>...) but the parent passes a plain setter (set('attachments', v)), so the updater FUNCTION was stored in state instead of an array. Replaced with local accumulation of the array. Please keep this fix; the same anti-pattern must not be reintroduced.

Admin can open a team/company item owned by someone else, edit fields and press Save; backend correctly returns 403 ('Only the owner can edit this') but the UI should render non-owned items read-only and hide pin/delete icons (pin returns 404, delete 403).
File size shows '0 KB' for files under 512 bytes (Math.round of size/1024).

issues: When all items are pinned, an empty 'RECENT' section heading is still rendered with no cards below it (seen in admin view) — hide the heading when recent.length === 0.
Reminder card shows date without year ('15 Jan · 09:00'), ambiguous for past/other-year reminders.
Mobile (390px): filter tab strip is horizontally scrollable so 'Tables'/'Files' are off-screen with no scroll affordance — acceptable but a fade/arrow hint would help.

action_items: Keep the Attachments upload fix in /app/frontend/src/pages/MySpace.jsx (functional-updater misuse crashed the app on every file/image upload).
Make the My Space editor read-only (and hide pin/delete) for items the current user does not own.
Add Pydantic enum validation for My Space `type`/`visibility`; switch PUT to exclude_unset so fields can be cleared.
Hide the empty 'Recent' heading when there are no unpinned items; show year on reminder cards.
Fix 2 eslint errors in MySpace.jsx: unescaped apostrophe (line 262) and empty catch block (line 371).
critical_code_review_comments: Never pass a React functional updater to a prop that expects a value — Attachments did onChange(prev => [...]) while the parent did setF(x => ({...x, attachments: v})), storing a function in state (app-breaking).
server.py is 1310 lines; My Space should be split into its own router module (routers/myspace.py) for maintainability.

process_due_reminders runs lazily inside GET /api/notifications, so reminders only fire when the owner polls notifications — acceptable but means reminders are never delivered to a logged-out user; consider a background task.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows pass after the attachment crash fix)

rca_of_the_issue: Attachments upload crash: `onChange((prev) => [...(prev || items), attachment])` in MySpace.jsx passed an updater function to Editor's `set('attachments', v)`, so f.attachments became a function; the next render executed items.map on a function -> uncaught TypeError and CRA error overlay, making the editor and page unusable and blocking every file/image upload. Fixed by accumulating the array locally and calling onChange(nextArray).
